title: Automated Discovery and Formal Verification of Combinatorial Properties in Integer Sequences

contributions.purpose: 完整刻画 OEIS 序列 A108702(循环约束置换)
contributions.mechanism: 边界元素分情形归纳证明递推 a(n)=a(n-2)+a(n-3),再代数推导常生成函数 (1+x+x^2)/(1-x^2-x^3) 与渐近增长
contributions.evaluation: 生成函数系数与已知项核对至 n=50;渐近增长率 alpha 约 1.4656(x^3-x-1 最大实根)
contributions.domain: 组合数学 / 整数序列
contributions.source_quote: Theoretical Results: Complete characterization of sequence A108702, including formal proof of its conjectured recurrence relation and derivation of its ordinary generating function with closed-form expression.

contributions.purpose: 发现 Ordered Bell 数的素数模恒等式
contributions.mechanism: 由递推与指数生成函数 1/(2-e^x) 结合 Wilson/Fermat 小定理分析系数模 p 行为,证明 a(p) ≡ 1 (mod p)
contributions.evaluation: 对所有素数 p<=97 计算验证(如 a(5)=541≡1 mod 5)
contributions.source_quote: Novel Discovery: A new modular arithmetic property for the Ordered Bell numbers (A000587), establishing a previously unknown connection between this classical sequence and prime number theory.

contributions.purpose: 界定自动发现方法的复杂度边界(负结果)
contributions.mechanism: 对 A181343 穷举搜索线性/多项式系数递推、Pade 逼近生成函数,均失败;转而做比值渐近分析
contributions.evaluation: 阶数至 15、次数至 5 的递推搜索无果,判定非 holonomic;比值收敛于 1/e,提出猜想 a(n) ~ (n-1)!/e(n=25 时比值 0.3664 vs 1/e≈0.3679)
contributions.source_quote: Complexity Analysis: Comprehensive investigation of sequence A181343 that reveals fundamental structural complexity and establishes negative results about the existence of simple recurrence relations.

contributions.purpose: 提供可复用的自动化数学发现方法论
contributions.mechanism: 三阶段流水线:量化标准选序列(引用稀疏+数据充分+带猜想)-> 多模态猜想生成(递推/生成函数/数论变换)-> 形式证明与计算验证
contributions.evaluation: 在 3 个异质序列上跑通完整发现-猜想-证明闭环(2 个成功、1 个揭示边界)
contributions.domain: AI for Math / 自动定理发现
contributions.source_quote: Methodological Framework: A complete automated research methodology applicable to other mathematical domains, with detailed analysis of capabilities and limitations.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our approach differs by integrating discovery and proof within a unified framework specifically designed for integer sequence analysis, addressing the complete research pipeline from data analysis to formal proof.

notes: reject。含明确负结果:A181343 递推搜索失败并自称建立 negative results(C3)。AI involvement checklist 四项全为 Full AI involvement (D),自述局限包括无法自主发展新证明策略、超越复杂度时失效。可信度问题:论文称 A000587 为 Ordered Bell(Fubini)数,但给出的序列 1,1,3,13,75,541 实为 A000670,A000587 在 OEIS 中是 complemented Bell 数,OEIS 编号疑为幻觉错配;Fubini 数 a(p)≡1 (mod p) 亦有既有文献,"previously unknown" 的新颖性存疑;Theorem 5 证明关键步骤含糊("careful analysis ... ensures"),Theorem 1 的 Case 2 依赖计算核验而非完整论证,标题的 "Formal Verification" 并无机械化证明支撑。
